name: Principal
trust_boundary: May cross identity, tenant and federation boundaries.

name: Authenticator
trust_boundary: Private authentication material remains within its authenticator boundary.

name: Session
trust_boundary: Crosses client, gateway and service boundaries with bounded lifetime.

name: Credential
trust_boundary: Issuer, holder and verifier are distinct trust roles.

name: Authorization Grant
trust_boundary: Approval or grant crosses into issuance but is not an access token.

name: Entitlement Tuple
trust_boundary: Relationship store and decision service are separate boundaries.

name: Policy Bundle
trust_boundary: Administration signs policy distributed to decision points.

name: Attribute Assertion
trust_boundary: Attribute authority, cache and decision point have separate freshness risks.

name: Access Token
trust_boundary: Issuer, client and resource server boundaries create replay exposure.

name: Dataset
trust_boundary: Moves across source, pipeline, persistence and consumer boundaries.

name: Field Value
trust_boundary: Sensitivity can differ from the enclosing dataset and change under combination.

name: Security Classification
trust_boundary: Label propagation crosses schema, lineage and enforcement systems.

name: Purpose Declaration
trust_boundary: Purpose authority and executing pipeline are distinct boundaries.

name: Consent Artifact
trust_boundary: Capture channel, ledger and enforcement path have different evidence.

name: Data Use Contract
trust_boundary: External obligation must be translated into testable platform terms.

name: Retention Schedule
trust_boundary: Schedule authority and storage deletion mechanisms are distinct.

name: Residency Constraint
trust_boundary: Control plane, data plane, backup and support access locations differ.

name: Cryptographic Key
trust_boundary: Custody boundary differs from data protected by the key.

name: Secret Version
trust_boundary: Manager, delivery agent and consuming workload are separate boundaries.

name: Encrypted Payload
trust_boundary: Ciphertext confidentiality depends on key and metadata boundaries.

name: Tenant Namespace
trust_boundary: Logical naming does not itself prove compute or storage isolation.

name: Compute Enclave
trust_boundary: Host, hardware, guest and remote verifier have distinct trust.

name: Clean Room Input
trust_boundary: Participant, operator and other participants must be independently modeled.

name: Approved Aggregate
trust_boundary: Output crosses from restricted computation into consumption.

name: Privacy Budget
trust_boundary: Budget must compose across analysts, queries, datasets and releases.

name: Deidentified Release
trust_boundary: Release boundary changes attacker access and auxiliary information.

name: Rights Case
trust_boundary: Identity verification must be separated from record disclosure.

name: Audit Record
trust_boundary: Producer, collector, store and analyst form successive trust boundaries.

name: Provenance Graph
trust_boundary: Assertions may be reported by untrusted producers and require validation.

name: Attestation Evidence
trust_boundary: Attester, verifier, endorser and relying party are distinct roles.

name: Transparency Checkpoint
trust_boundary: Log operator and independent monitors must not be conflated.

name: Software Artifact
trust_boundary: Source, build, registry and deployment boundaries permit substitution.

name: Sbom
trust_boundary: Inventory describes components but does not prove the built artifact contains them.

name: Provenance Attestation
trust_boundary: Signature proves signer control, not truth of predicate.

name: Incident Bundle
trust_boundary: Collection, preservation, transfer and analysis require chain of custody.

name: Waiver
trust_boundary: Approval authority and enforcement point must agree on scope and expiry.

name: Lineage Edge
trust_boundary: Observed derivation is not necessarily causal proof.

name: Compiler Requirement
trust_boundary: Requirement is provider-neutral and must not name an implementation as proof.

name: Capability Offer
trust_boundary: Offer claims require qualification and freshness.

name: Decision Receipt
trust_boundary: Receipt is scoped to input facts, policy edition and evaluation time.
